title: To: Samir Haddad · From: Seaview Lodge · Subject: Your reservation
L: Dear Mr. Haddad, Thank you for booking two nights at the Seaview Lodge.
Your room will be ready for check-in from 3:00 P.M. on July 2.
Because you mentioned that you will arrive late, we have arranged for the night manager to give you your key at the front desk.
The front desk is staffed twenty-four hours a day.
Breakfast is served in the garden café from 7:00 to 10:00 A.M. and is included in your rate.
Furthermore, guests can borrow bicycles free of charge to explore the coastal path.
If you need anything before your stay, please do not hesitate to contact us.
We look forward to welcoming you.

exq.why: Ngày nhận phòng 2/7 ở tương lai → will be ready.

exq.a: The front desk is staffed twenty-four hours a day.
w: The garden café is closed for renovations.
Bicycles must be returned by noon on July 1.
Please check in before noon so that we can prepare your room.
exq.why: Nối với ý khách đến muộn, nhận chìa khoá ở quầy → quầy có người trực cả ngày đêm. Ba câu kia trái với đoạn (quán vẫn phục vụ bữa sáng, khách chưa tới ngày 1/7, nhận phòng từ 15:00).
Thêm một tiện ích nữa (mượn xe đạp miễn phí) sau bữa sáng → Furthermore.
contact us = liên hệ với chúng tôi. reply, respond, communicate cần giới từ (reply to, respond to, communicate with).
